data.one_liner: A data visualization library based on Apache ECharts for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Graphify bridges Flutter and Apache ECharts, enabling developers to render advanced charts like WebGL 3D, bar, line, candlestick, radar, and graphs using JSON configurations.
use_when: You need advanced charts like WebGL 3D, candlestick, or graphs using Apache ECharts.
You prefer configuring charts via JSON objects based on the ECharts documentation.
avoid_when: You require pure Dart chart rendering without webviews.
You need a lightweight native charting solution with zero web dependencies.
strengths: Leverages the full feature set of Apache ECharts.
Supports advanced visualizations like WebGL 3D, tree, and radar charts.
weaknesses: Relies on webview_flutter under the hood.
Chart configurations are passed as dynamic JSON maps rather than typed Dart models.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a pure Flutter charting library without webview dependencies.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a comprehensive, native, enterprise-grade charting library.
